data.name: Storm Burst
data.description: As a standard action, the shaman causes a small storm of swirling wind and rain to form around one creature within 30 feet. This storm causes the target to treat all foes as if they had concealment, suffering a 20%% miss chance for %1 rounds. The shaman can use this ability %2/day.|ShamanStormBurstDuration|ShamanStormBurstTimes
